Content: I don't consider this a horror game but a terror game which is lesser in my opinion. Because terror games generally do not have any dangerous threat at least not until the end where it likely just kills you without a chance to relatiate. Terror games are boring because it is just a bunch of jumpscares, ambience, and scary settings without anything to actually put you in danger. In my opinion people should avoid these kinds of games compared to actual horror games. And I think it would be best that the gaming industry actually make this distinction of horror and terror games. So people have a better understanding for what kind of games they are buying and using their time on to determine if it is worth it.

Content:
Oh this reminds me of the game i was trying to make years ago! You were also in a bunker with ghosts and you were also a random reddit/4chan user.

But, my idea was that you were trying to collect seven documents instead of photos and the ghosts were guarding the documents. You get hit by a ghost 2 times(or if you take lethal damage from the traps) you die. 

When you die you "respawn" at the entrance with all of your progress staying the same. Everything you gathered stays were you died(or nearby if need be) and over your stuff is a afterimage of your player. Only, once you get closer to the afterimage it turns and starts chasing *you*. 

The gimmick I was aiming for was that everytime you respawned you came back as another user, but the previous user becomes a new ghost to chase you. 

I gave up on it because i couldn't figure out how to set up the primary gimmick. Could probably do it with Unreal or one of the moderm game building systems now, but...eh don't have the spark anymore
